sub_graphs.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Trie
sub_graphs.description: Merkle Patricia Trie implementation for Osaka fork. Defines Trie, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode, trie_set, trie_get, root computation, nibble encoding, and EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT.

sub_graphs.name: Trie Node Data Structures
sub_graphs.description: Defines the core data structures used to represent nodes in the Merkle Patricia Trie: LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode, and the Trie container itself. All node dataclasses use @slotted_freezable for immutability after construction.

invariants.text: LeafNode, ExtensionNode, and BranchNode are frozen (immutable) after creation via @slotted_freezable decorator.
BranchSubnodes is a fixed-length tuple of exactly 16 Extended elements, corresponding to the 16 possible nibble values (0x0-0xF).
InternalNode is a union type of exactly LeafNode | ExtensionNode | BranchNode — no other node types are permitted internally.
Node is a union type: Account | Bytes | LegacyTransaction | Receipt | Uint | U256 | Withdrawal | None — representing all values storable in the trie.
The Trie generic container is parameterized by K (key type, bound to Bytes) and V (value type, constrained to specific Optional union types).

state_variables.name: LeafNode.rest_of_key
state_variables.description: The remaining portion of the key (in nibble form) that uniquely identifies this leaf within its branch path.

state_variables.name: LeafNode.value
state_variables.description: The RLP-encoded value stored at this leaf node.

state_variables.name: ExtensionNode.key_segment
state_variables.description: The shared key prefix (in nibble form) that this extension node compresses.

state_variables.name: ExtensionNode.subnode
state_variables.description: The encoded child node that follows this extension's key segment.

state_variables.name: BranchNode.subnodes
state_variables.description: Fixed-length tuple of 16 child references, one for each possible nibble value (0x0-0xF).

state_variables.name: BranchNode.value
state_variables.description: The value stored at this branch node itself (for keys that terminate exactly at this branch level).

state_variables.name: Trie.secured
state_variables.description: If True, keys are keccak256-hashed before insertion, creating a 'secure' trie.

state_variables.name: Trie.default
state_variables.description: The default value returned for missing keys and used to determine deletion (value == default triggers removal).

state_variables.name: Trie._data
state_variables.description: Internal dictionary storing the key-value pairs of the trie. Keys are raw (pre-hashing) byte sequences.

data_structures.name: LeafNode
data_structures.description: Leaf node in the Merkle Trie. Stores the remaining key suffix and the associated value.

data_structures.name: ExtensionNode
data_structures.description: Extension node in the Merkle Trie. Compresses a shared key prefix into a single node pointing to a subnode.

data_structures.name: BranchNode
data_structures.description: Branch node in the Merkle Trie. Contains 16 child slots (one per nibble) plus an optional value.

data_structures.name: Trie
data_structures.description: The Merkle Trie container. A generic key-value store with optional key hashing (secured mode) and a default value for missing keys.

data_structures.name: BranchSubnodes
data_structures.definition: Tuple[Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended, Extended]
data_structures.description: Type alias for a fixed 16-element tuple of Extended values, representing the 16 child slots of a BranchNode.

data_structures.name: Node
data_structures.definition: Account | Bytes | LegacyTransaction | Receipt | Uint | U256 | Withdrawal | None
data_structures.description: Union type representing all possible values that can be stored as trie nodes.

data_structures.name: InternalNode
data_structures.description: Union type representing all internal trie node types used during patricialisation and encoding.

sub_graphs.name: Trie Constants and Sentinel Values
sub_graphs.description: Defines key constants for the trie module, most importantly EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT which is the keccak256 hash of the RLP encoding of an empty byte string.

invariants.text: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT == keccak256(RLP(b'')) == 0x56e81f171bcc55a6ff8345e692c0f86e5b48e01b996cadc001622fb5e363b421. This is the canonical root hash for any empty trie (secured or unsecured).
keccak256(RLP(())) == 0x1dcc4de8dec75d7aab85b567b6ccd41ad312451b948a7413f0a142fd40d49347, which is the sha3Uncles hash in block headers with no uncles. (Documented but not a variable in this module.)

state_variables.name: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT
state_variables.description: The root hash of an empty Merkle Patricia Trie. Equal to keccak256(RLP(b'')), value 0x56e81f171bcc55a6ff8345e692c0f86e5b48e01b996cadc001622fb5e363b421.

sub_graphs.name: Trie CRUD Operations (Set, Get, Copy)
sub_graphs.description: Core read/write operations on the Trie data structure: trie_set for inserting/deleting entries, trie_get for lookups, and copy_trie for shallow copying.

invariants.text: Setting a key to the trie's default value is equivalent to deleting the key. After trie_set(trie, key, trie.default), the key must not be present in trie._data.
trie_get always returns trie.default for keys not present in the trie. It never raises a KeyError.
copy_trie produces a shallow copy of _data; since only frozen (immutable) objects are stored, this is safe and the copy is independent of the original.

functions.name: trie_set
functions.signature: trie_set(trie: Trie[K, V], key: K, value: V) -> None
functions.description: Stores an item in the Merkle Trie. Deletes the key if value equals trie.default (since the trie represents default values by omission). Otherwise sets trie._data[key] = value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to insert. If equal to trie.default, the key is deleted.

side_effects: Mutates trie._data: inserts or deletes a key-value pair.

functions.name: trie_get
functions.signature: trie_get(trie: Trie[K, V], key: K) -> V
functions.description: Gets an item from the Merkle Trie. Returns trie.default if the key is missing.

functions.name: copy_trie
functions.description: Creates a shallow copy of the trie. Since only frozen (immutable) objects may be stored, contents are safely reused.

preconditions.text: The trie parameter must be a valid Trie instance. The key must be of type K (bound to Bytes). The value must match the trie's value type V.

postconditions.text: If value == trie.default and key was in trie._data, then key is no longer in trie._data after the call.
If value != trie.default, then trie._data[key] == value after the call.
Returns trie._data[key] if key is present, otherwise returns trie.default. The trie is not modified.
The returned Trie has the same secured, default, and _data contents but _data is a distinct dict object (mutations to the copy do not affect the original).

sub_graphs.name: Nibble Encoding and Compact Serialization
sub_graphs.description: Handles conversion between byte sequences and nibble lists, as well as Hex-Prefix (HP) compact encoding used in the MPT specification. Nibbles are 4-bit values (0-15) that represent individual hex digits of keys.

invariants.text: bytes_to_nibble_list produces a Bytes of length 2*len(input), where each output byte is in range [0, 15].
nibble_list_to_compact encodes the is_leaf flag and parity in the highest nibble: bit 1 = is_leaf, bit 0 = parity (odd length). The encoding is reversible.
For even-length nibble lists, a leading zero nibble is prepended (with flag in high nibble). For odd-length, the first nibble of the key is packed with the flag nibble.

functions.name: nibble_list_to_compact
functions.description: Compresses a nibble-list into a standard byte array with a Hex-Prefix flag. The flag nibble encodes both the is_leaf status and the parity of the nibble count. Even-length lists get a 0-nibble prefix; odd-length lists pack the first nibble with the flag.

parameters.name: is_leaf
parameters.description: True for leaf nodes, False for extension nodes.

encoding_table.odd_leaf: high nibble = 0x3X (0011 XXXX) where X = first nibble
encoding_table.odd_extension: high nibble = 0x1X (0001 XXXX) where X = first nibble

functions.name: bytes_to_nibble_list
functions.description: Converts a Bytes sequence into a nibble-list format where each byte is split into two nibbles (high and low 4 bits).

functions.name: common_prefix_length
functions.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix of two sequences. Returns the number of matching elements from the start.

preconditions.text: All values in x must be in range [0, 15] (valid nibble values).
Input must be a valid Bytes sequence.

postconditions.text: The output is a valid Hex-Prefix encoded byte array. The first byte encodes the flag nibble. The encoding preserves all information needed to reconstruct the original nibble list and is_leaf flag.
Output has length exactly 2 * len(input). Each output byte is in [0, 15].

sub_graphs.name: Node Encoding (RLP Serialization)
sub_graphs.description: Handles RLP encoding of internal trie nodes (LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode) and external node types (Account, Transaction, Receipt, etc.). Internal nodes are encoded to their RLP form and hashed with keccak256 if the encoding is >= 32 bytes.

invariants.text: None nodes are encoded as b'' (empty bytes).
If the RLP encoding of a node is less than 32 bytes, the raw RLP structure (unencoded) is returned instead of its hash. This is the 'inline node' optimization.
If the RLP encoding of a node is >= 32 bytes, the keccak256 hash of the encoding is returned.
LeafNode is encoded as (nibble_list_to_compact(rest_of_key, True), value) — is_leaf flag is always True.
ExtensionNode is encoded as (nibble_list_to_compact(key_segment, False), subnode) — is_leaf flag is always False.
BranchNode is encoded as a 17-element list: the 16 subnodes followed by the value.

functions.name: encode_internal_node
functions.description: Encodes a Merkle Trie internal node into its RLP form. If the RLP serialization is < 32 bytes, returns the unencoded structure directly (inline); otherwise returns keccak256 of the serialized bytes. None is encoded as b''.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The internal node to encode. None represents absence.

error_conditions: Raises AssertionError if node is not None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode.

functions.name: encode_node
functions.signature: encode_node(node: Node, storage_root: Optional[Bytes] = None) -> Bytes
functions.description: Encodes a Node (external value) for storage in the Merkle Trie. Dispatches based on node type: Account uses encode_account with storage_root, Transaction/Receipt/Withdrawal/U256 use rlp.encode, Bytes is returned as-is, and other types delegate to previous_trie.encode_node.

parameters.name: storage_root
parameters.description: The storage root for Account nodes. Required when node is Account.

error_conditions: Asserts storage_root is not None when node is an Account.

preconditions.text: Node must be None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode.
If node is an Account, storage_root must not be None.

postconditions.text: Returns either an inline RLP structure (if serialized form < 32 bytes) or a 32-byte keccak256 hash.
Returns the RLP-encoded bytes representation of the node suitable for insertion into the trie.

sub_graphs.name: Trie Root Computation
sub_graphs.description: Computes the Merkle Patricia Trie root hash. This is the top-level entry point that prepares the trie data, recursively patricializes it into an internal node tree, and computes the final root hash.

invariants.text: An empty trie always produces EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT (0x56e81f171bcc55a6ff8345e692c0f86e5b48e01b996cadc001622fb5e363b421).
For secured tries, all keys are keccak256-hashed before trie construction during _prepare_trie.
The root hash is deterministic: the same set of key-value pairs always produces the same root regardless of insertion order.
If the RLP encoding of the root node is < 32 bytes, it is hashed with keccak256 anyway (unlike internal nodes which can be inlined). This ensures root is always a 32-byte hash.
During _prepare_trie, any value that encodes to b'' triggers an AssertionError — empty-encoded values must not exist in the prepared mapping.

functions.name: root
functions.signature: root(trie: Trie[K, V], get_storage_root: Optional[Callable[[Address], Root]] = None) -> Root
functions.description: Computes the root hash of a modified Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT). First prepares the trie data (hashing keys if secured, encoding values), then recursively patricializes the data into internal nodes, and finally encodes the root node. If the root encoding is < 32 bytes, it is keccak256-hashed; otherwise the hash is used directly.

parameters.name: trie
parameters.description: The trie to compute the root of.

parameters.name: get_storage_root
parameters.description: Function to get the storage root of an account. Required when trie contains Account values.

functions.name: _prepare_trie
functions.signature: _prepare_trie(trie: Trie[K, V], get_storage_root: Optional[Callable[[Address], Root]] = None) -> Mapping[Bytes, Bytes]
functions.description: Prepares the trie for root calculation. Iterates all key-value pairs, encodes each value via encode_node, hashes keys with keccak256 (if secured), and converts keys to nibble-list format. Returns a mapping from nibble-encoded keys to encoded values.

parameters.name: get_storage_root
parameters.description: Function to get storage root for Account encoding.

error_conditions: Raises AssertionError if any encoded_value is b'' (empty bytes).
Raises AssertionError if get_storage_root is None but an Account value is encountered.

state_transitions.description: Trie data (Dict[K, V]) is transformed through _prepare_trie into Mapping[Bytes, Bytes] where keys are nibble-encoded (and optionally keccak256-hashed) and values are RLP-encoded.
state_transitions.from_state: trie._data: Dict[K, V] with raw keys and typed values
state_transitions.to_state: Mapping[Bytes, Bytes] with nibble-list keys and RLP-encoded values

preconditions.text: If the trie contains Account values, get_storage_root must be provided.
All values in the trie must encode to non-empty bytes. No value may have an empty RLP encoding.

postconditions.text: Returns a 32-byte Root hash. For an empty trie this equals EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT.
Returns a mapping where every key is in nibble-list format and every value is a non-empty RLP-encoded byte string.

sub_graphs.name: Recursive Patricialisation (Trie Construction)
sub_graphs.description: The core recursive algorithm that converts a flat mapping of nibble-encoded keys to encoded values into a tree of InternalNode objects (LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode). This implements the Modified Merkle Patricia Trie construction algorithm.

invariants.text: An empty mapping produces None (no node).
A single-entry mapping produces a LeafNode with rest_of_key = key[level:] and value = the entry's value.
If all keys share a common prefix at the current level (prefix_length > 0), an ExtensionNode is created to compress that prefix.
If keys diverge at the current level (prefix_length == 0), a BranchNode is created with 16 child slots. Keys are distributed to child slots based on their nibble at the current level.

Keys that terminate exactly at a branch level (len(key) == level) store their value in the BranchNode's value field. Account, Receipt, and Uint types must not appear at internal branch values (triggers AssertionError).
Recursive calls to patricialize always increment level, ensuring termination as keys are finite-length.

functions.name: patricialize
functions.signature: patricialize(obj: Mapping[Bytes, Bytes], level: Uint) -> Optional[InternalNode]
functions.description: Structural composition function that recursively patricializes and merkleizes a dictionary of key-value pairs. At each level, determines whether to create a LeafNode (single entry), ExtensionNode (shared prefix), or BranchNode (diverging keys). Child nodes are recursively patricialised and then encoded via encode_internal_node.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Key-value pairs with keys in nibble-list format.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Current trie depth (index into key nibble lists).

error_conditions: Raises AssertionError if a key terminating at a branch level has a value of type Account, Receipt, or Uint.

algorithm.step_1: If obj is empty, return None.
algorithm.step_2: If obj has exactly one entry, return LeafNode(key[level:], value).
algorithm.step_3: Find the longest common prefix among all keys starting at 'level'.
algorithm.step_4: If common prefix length > 0, create ExtensionNode(prefix, encode_internal_node(patricialize(obj, level+prefix_length))).
algorithm.step_5: Otherwise, create BranchNode: distribute entries into 16 buckets by nibble at 'level', recursively patricialize each bucket, and encode the child nodes.

state_transitions.description: Flat Mapping[Bytes, Bytes] is recursively decomposed into a tree of InternalNode objects (LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode) where each child is encoded via encode_internal_node.
state_transitions.from_state: Mapping[Bytes, Bytes] — flat key-value pairs in nibble-list format
state_transitions.to_state: Optional[InternalNode] — recursive tree of LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode

preconditions.text: All keys in obj must be in nibble-list format (each byte in [0, 15]). Level must be <= the length of the shortest key.

postconditions.text: Returns None if obj is empty, LeafNode for single entry, ExtensionNode if all keys share a prefix at level, or BranchNode otherwise. All child references are encoded via encode_internal_node (either inline RLP or keccak256 hash).

sub_graphs.name: Fork Inheritance from Prague
sub_graphs.description: The Osaka trie module explicitly imports and delegates to the Prague fork's trie implementation (previous_trie) for node types not handled by the Osaka-specific encode_node function. This establishes the fork inheritance chain.

invariants.text: encode_node delegates to previous_trie.encode_node (Prague fork) for node types not explicitly handled by Osaka's encode_node (i.e., types other than Account, LegacyTransaction, Receipt, Withdrawal, U256, Bytes).
The Osaka fork's trie module is a complete, self-contained implementation — it does not inherit the full trie structure from Prague, only the encode_node fallback.

dependencies.usage: Hashing for secure trie keys and node encoding.
RLP encoding/decoding of all node types.
Account type and encoding for state trie.
Receipt and Withdrawal types as Node union members.
LegacyTransaction type as Node union member.
